description: Use case: the table of the third-party revenues of ABB Ltd by business area and region in million USD for 2024 and 2025 as published in the ABB Financial Report 2025, the example of the table editor (src/test/resources/web/html/use_cases/table_editor_sample.html). The rows are the phrases that are a 'sector of revenue', the sub-rows are the regions linked by 'is part of'; each business area is a triple of ABB e.g. 'ABB Electrification', so that its abbreviation, its parent and its values are never part of the data of the shared word e.g. 'electrification' that another page uses; the Robotics division is sold to SoftBank Group, so it is shown with its revenue as a discontinued operation and has no regions. The columns are the years, the growth against the prior year and the share of the total of the latest year, the source and the confidence, each column item with its tier as a choice triple to the to side of the tier keyword e.g. 'mayor' of 'mayor column (system)', because a triple to the tier keyword itself would be listed with the column tiers of every table. The definition of the table is a triple from 'sector of revenue' to each table keyword of editor_views.json: a text in the description of the triple, a number as a value with the keyword, a flag as the triple itself and a choice as a triple from the parameter triple to the selected phrase; a flag that is off and an empty parameter have no triple.

words.name: automation
words.description: the control of a process or a machine by a technical system instead of a person, e.g. the control system of a chemical plant

words.name: Americas
words.description: North, Central and South America together, e.g. as a sales region of a company

words.name: AMEA
words.description: Asia, Middle East and Africa, a sales region of a company e.g. of ABB

words.name: listed
words.description: in the order of the list as it is given, e.g. the own columns of a table in the order the user has set

words.name: subject
words.description: the from side of a triple, e.g. 'ABB Motion' in 'ABB Motion is a sector of revenue'

words.name: show
words.description: to display something, e.g. a table row without a value

words.name: expanded
words.description: opened, so that the parts below are visible, e.g. the sub-rows of a table row

words.name: own
words.description: belonging to the object itself and not derived from its parts, e.g. the own value of a parent row instead of the sum of its children

words.name: siblings
words.description: the phrases with the same parent, e.g. the sub-sectors of one sector

words.name: dash
words.description: the sign - shown in place of a missing number

words.name: none
words.description: nothing of the kind, e.g. no delta shown

words.name: auto
words.description: decided by the system from the type of the content, e.g. numbers right and texts left

words.name: preferred
words.description: chosen before the others, e.g. the value of the preferred source if several sources have a value

words.name: scroll
words.description: to move the visible part of a page or a table, e.g. a wide table on a small screen

words.name: static
words.description: not updated by itself, only when the page is read again

words.name: English
words.description: the language of England, the USA and many other countries, e.g. the language of the texts of a table

words.name: csv
words.description: comma-separated values, a text format with one line per table row

words.name: json
words.description: JavaScript Object Notation, a text format for structured data

words.name: visible
words.description: what the user sees at the moment, e.g. the rows of the current page of a table
